latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release — convert static images into animated video clips with cloud AI.

- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF files (max 200MB) to generate smooth animated videos with transitions.
- No video editing skills required; just describe your desired result.
- Ideal for marketers and social media creators; export in MP4 and other popular formats.
- Built-in credit system; anonymous users receive free trial credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports previewing, editing, and exporting video content, all processed on secure GPU servers.
